name: Live Electronics
summary: Shenzhen Live Electronics Co., Ltd. develops and supplies custom electronic control boards and PCBA solutions. Its explicit robot-controller range contains patrol-robot and cleaning-robot boards; the company also offers unrelated home, industrial and power electronics. Published robot model tables are configuration baselines for custom integration.
categories: Robot Control Boards and Computing Components
